name: Priya Nandan
text: The Ravello table arrived with a hand-written note from the maker. Two years and a lot of dinner parties later it still looks like the day it landed.

name: James Okafor
text: I measured the stairwell wrong and they collected, re-routed and re-delivered without charging me. That is the whole reason I came back for the armchair.

name: Sarah Belmont
text: Beautiful piece and genuinely comfortable. Took a fortnight longer than quoted, but they kept me posted the entire time rather than going quiet.

name: Michael Tran
text: The brass pendant throws exactly the warm light I was after. Packaging was all cardboard and paper too, which I appreciated.

name: Eleni Vasilakis
text: Bought the bed frame after seeing it in the showroom. The team spent forty minutes with me and never once tried to upsell.

name: Daniel Rowe
text: Third order in four years. The oak has aged exactly the way they said it would, which is more than I can say for the last lot I bought.
